metadata.M_semantics: selected ADAPT ansatz operators; an ADAPT size analogue, not a Rayleigh-Ritz subspace dimension
metadata.kappa_S_semantics: not defined: ADAPT-VQE has no overlap matrix

metadata.budget_semantics: budget below the sampled seed size: seed and outside determinants ranked together by estimated squared amplitude (Ritz weight for the seed, first-order estimate outside) so both compete under one criterion. Seed determinants winning every slot is then a result about the sample, not an artifact of ranking them first
reference determinant plus the highest-scoring determinants under one criterion, chosen without reference to the sampled set; the quantum sample informs neither the pool nor the order
